subject.title: fix(codex): stop stale MCP child processes with revalidated SIGKILL escalation

question: Is there a supported macOS process identity contract strong enough to authorize delayed SIGKILL of a reused PID, or should stale-child cleanup remain SIGTERM-only until one exists?
rationale: The correct behavior trades cleanup reliability against the risk of force-terminating a newly launched helper, and the proposed `ps lstart` comparison does not by itself establish that safety boundary.

options.title: Use a stronger launch identity
options.body: Adopt a macOS-supported, collision-resistant identity and prove that both the original child and a replacement child are handled safely.

options.title: Keep SIGTERM-only cleanup
options.body: Avoid a delayed hard kill until the Codex app-server can provide a process handle or authoritative launch identity.

recommendation.title: Use a stronger launch identity
recommendation.body: Adopt a macOS-supported, collision-resistant identity and prove that both the original child and a replacement child are handled safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat owns the proposed implementation and can supply the missing runtime evidence while an area owner decides the identity contract.
